latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of the Enterprise Architecture Pattern Stack Selector skill.

- Enables selection of enterprise application architecture patterns for domain-logic, persistence, and web-presentation layers using Fowler's PEAA decision framework.
- Guides users in mapping subsystem context (stack, scope, domain complexity, commitments) to recommended pattern families per layer.
- Produces a consolidated Pattern Stack Decision Record documenting rationale and choices.
- Supports greenfield app design, subsystem evaluation, legacy refactoring, team alignment, and architecture reviews.
- Works from either user-provided descriptions or by analyzing codebase artifacts (language, ORM, framework, structure).
- Not intended for microservice topology or single-pattern implementation detail decisions.
